pr.title: Add async test coverage
pr.description: Tests run with python3 -m unittest discover -s tests; default unittest warning handling, no configured lint rules.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+import unittest
+from subject import load_name
+
+class NameTests(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
+    async def assert_loaded_name(self):
+        self.assertEqual(await load_name(), "Michael")
+
+    async def test_loads_name(self):
+        await self.assert_loaded_name()
